description: Full Gojiberry feature parity on Attainly + Attainly's exceptional moat (evidence gate, deliverability/reputation OS, HITL proof). One story per loop iteration.

userStories.title: Website → Agent Config (Gojiberry Connect)
userStories.description: As a founder, I paste my website and get ICP, offer, cure, signals, and first message drafts in minutes.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing website intake works end-to-end in UI with editable review
Outputs: company, offer, ICP, client_cure, suggested signals, subject/body drafts
SSRF-safe fetch; honest fallback if LLM down
userStories.notes: Parity with Gojiberry 'Enter your website'. Prefer Firecrawl upgrade if quick.

userStories.title: Intent signal types catalog + matrix UI
userStories.description: As an operator, I can choose buying/social signal types like competitor engagement, funding, job change, hiring, follows, topic activity.
acceptanceCriteria: Documented catalog of supported signal types in API + UI multiselect
Campaign signal_matrix.allowed_signal_types enforced fail-closed when empty
userStories.notes: Gojiberry signal radar. Ingest can still be simulate/provider-backed.

userStories.title: ICP pre-filter before any outreach
userStories.description: As an operator, non-ICP prospects never enter the send path.
acceptanceCriteria: Prospects scored/filtered against campaign ICP description or structured ICP fields
Below-threshold ICP fit blocked from plan/dispatch

userStories.title: Hybrid lead scoring (ICP + intent + freshness)
userStories.description: As an operator, I see a 0-100 score combining ICP fit, signal strength, and freshness/decay.
acceptanceCriteria: Score stored on prospect and returned by API
Decay or freshness reduces score for stale signals
UI shows score on prospect list

userStories.title: Lookalike audience from best customers
userStories.description: As an operator, I can seed lookalikes from won/best accounts.
acceptanceCriteria: API accepts seed companies/contacts and produces lookalike candidate list (provider or heuristic MVP)
Candidates still must pass ICP + signal gates before send
Honest Prototype label if provider missing

userStories.title: Signal-grounded AI copy (email)
userStories.description: As an operator, every first-touch draft cites real signal evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Stacked campaigns fail closed without evidence

userStories.title: Agent-coordinated email cadence (no manual sequence builder required)
userStories.description: As an operator, the agent proposes follow-up steps without forcing a complex sequence UI; optional simple cadence settings exist.
acceptanceCriteria: First touch + 1-3 follow-ups can be generated as jobs with delays
Operator can approve cadence defaults per campaign
userStories.notes: Gojiberry 'no sequences to build' — keep simple + HITL.

userStories.title: Unified Inbox
userStories.description: As an operator, all prospect email replies live in one Unibox with next actions.

userStories.title: Full auto OR approve-before-send (Copilot + Autopilot)
userStories.description: As an operator, I choose Copilot (approve) or Autopilot (auto) per campaign; Guardian block always forces HITL.
acceptanceCriteria: UI toggle with clear risk copy

userStories.title: Reply Brain — pre-written replies ready
userStories.description: As an operator, when a prospect replies, a tailored next message is drafted for one-click approve.
acceptanceCriteria: Classifications create Action with draft for positive, OOO, postpone, unsubscribe at minimum

userStories.title: Weekly learning + benchmarks report
userStories.description: As an operator, I get a weekly insights report: what converted, which signals, recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint or scheduled job produces weekly summary per tenant/campaign
Includes signal→reply/meeting attribution when data exists
UI page or Campaign insights panel
userStories.notes: Gojiberry 'gets better every week'. Industry benchmark can be honest placeholder if no industry data.

userStories.title: Email enrichment waterfall adapter
userStories.description: As an operator, prospects can be enriched via a pluggable waterfall (15+ providers interface); works with 0-1 real providers + mocks.
acceptanceCriteria: Enrichment adapter interface + at least one mock + optional real provider hook via env
Enrichment results stored on contact; failures don't crash campaign
Honest label when no provider key

userStories.title: CRM sync + API + MCP surface
userStories.description: As an operator, I can sync outcomes to CRM via API/MCP with honest status.
acceptanceCriteria: Public API docs or routes for campaigns/prospects/outcomes that are tenant-authenticated
MCP gateway either works with a real dependency path OR UI clearly says Prototype

userStories.title: LinkedIn/Social channel — research + assisted outreach (safe)
userStories.description: As an operator, I can run LinkedIn/social as a second channel with safety limits OR export assisted steps — not reckless ban-bait automation.
acceptanceCriteria: MVP: either (A) generate LinkedIn message drafts + manual/send-assist checklist with daily caps, OR (B) integrate a compliant sender path if available
Cold WhatsApp/FB/IG DM blasting explicitly out of scope
userStories.notes: Gojiberry socials — implement safely. Prefer drafts+HITL over banned scrapers.

userStories.title: MOAT: Deliverability Guardian hard pre-send
userStories.description: As a domain owner, every send is scored for spam/AI-fingerprint risk; block forces HITL.
acceptanceCriteria: Guardian runs on plan path; block forces approval
Issues + fixes visible in Actions UI
userStories.notes: Attainly exceptional moat — not in Gojiberry core.

userStories.title: MOAT: Evidence-gated dispatch
userStories.description: As a domain owner, stacked campaigns cannot dispatch without fresh evidence.

userStories.title: MOAT: Reputation OS dashboard
userStories.description: As an operator/agency, I see mailbox reputation/health and pause reasons before scaling.
acceptanceCriteria: Unhealthy mailboxes excluded from smart dispatch

userStories.title: MOAT: Proof pack (meetings + COGS + health + traces)
userStories.description: As an agency, I can export/show proof: cost, meetings, margin, deliverability, trace ids.
acceptanceCriteria: Proof endpoint tenant-scoped with those fields
userStories.notes: Attainly moat — beats Gojiberry on trust/ROI proof.

userStories.title: Actions List as operator OS
userStories.description: As an operator, one Actions inbox is the daily cockpit (approve/reject/snooze/edit/rerun) with reasoning panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Actions UI complete with reasoning (evidence, guardian, trace)

userStories.title: Exceptional positioning docs + demo script
userStories.description: As a founder, docs state Gojiberry parity features + Attainly moat without overclaims.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/ATTAINLY_VS_GOJIBERRY.md exists with feature matrix Real/Partial/Prototype
Demo script: website → signals → evidence draft → guardian → approve → send → reply → proof
